description.zh:
是否强制删除ASM实例，取值：

- ` true`：强制删除ASM实例

- `false`：不强制删除ASM实例

默认值： false
description.en:
Specifies whether to force delete the ASM instance. Valid values:

- `true`: Force deletes the ASM instance.

- `false`: Does not force delete the ASM instance.

Default value: false.

description.zh: json格式的字符串，可以被解析为一个字符串数组。指定在删除网格时、需要保留的网格相关资源的列表，数组内的值是需要保留的资源的实例ID。
description.en: A JSON string that can be parsed into an array of strings. The array contains the instance IDs of the resources to retain when you delete the Service Mesh instance.

title.zh: 删除一个服务网格实例

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh delete-service-mesh --service-mesh-id c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --biz-force false --retain-resources lb-bp1fxvl3q8akbj6m00000_,_lb-bp1hoxkolggdw0y300000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh DeleteServiceMesh --region cn-hangzhou --RetainResources 'lb-bp1fxvl3q8akbj6m00000_,_lb-bp1hoxkolggdw0y300000' --ServiceMeshId c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --Force false
